section_job.evidence: The draft's four paragraphs follow the contract's exact required order — internal 4-tier governance, then Product-Led platform strategy (5 products), then Agile rationale-before-mechanism, then external data-exchange agreements last — matching the section_job field verbatim in sequence.

audience_decision_value.evidence: Every paragraph closes on what กรม สส. leadership should decide or do (e.g. 'กรม สส. จึงควรเริ่มจากการวางธรรมาภิบาลภายในและออกแบบ TOR แบบเน้นผลิตภัณฑ์ให้เดินหน้าก่อน'), foregrounding TOR-scoping and prioritization decisions rather than consultant workflow.

evidence_payload.evidence: Each argument unit has claim, concrete evidence, and consequence/mechanism: e.g. the external-agreement paragraph states the claim (should negotiate), evidence (97 datasets, ~37% held by 5 named agencies), and consequence (deprioritized because cross-agency negotiation is slower than internally-actionable work).

causal_logic.evidence: The Agile paragraph correctly sequences rationale before mechanism as the contract requires ('แนวทางนี้ดีกว่า...เพราะลดความเสี่ยง...ด้วยเหตุนี้ คณะที่ปรึกษาจึงเสนอให้กำหนด...'), and the closing paragraph correctly derives the external-agreement deprioritization from the negotiation-time argument rather than asserting it decoratively.

reader_facing_appropriateness.evidence: No evidence codes, slide/page locators, file paths, or commentary about document structure appear in the body text; the only structural marker is the approved figure placeholder for the 4-tier governance diagram.

terminology_agency.evidence: 'กรม สส.' is used consistently with no bare 'กรมฯ' or 'สส.'; 'คณะที่ปรึกษา' is the consistent sentence subject performing recommendation actions (เสนอ, จัดลำดับ); the banned term 'Standing Data Exchange Agreements' does not appear, and DCCE is correctly excluded from the 5-agency external list.

source_fidelity.evidence: All required_concepts are present including the two newest additions: MVP sequencing (foundational stats before economic Loss & Damage calculation) and NESDC named specifically for the loss-statistics service. Spot-checked directly against inbox_source/NESDC-Loss-and-damage-database-presentation-slide.md: page 12 lists exactly the physical-quantity categories (พื้นที่เพาะปลูกเสียหาย, พื้นที่สิ่งปลูกสร้างเสียหาย, โครงสร้างพื้นฐานเสียหาย, ทรัพย์สิน/บ้านเรือนเสียหาย) as the foundational data layer, and pages 13-17 show concrete per-sector Damage/Loss calculation formulas with named data sources (ปภ., สำนักงบประมาณ, VAT, กระทรวงเกษตรและสหกรณ์, etc.) — confirming NESDC holds real, usable methodology and not merely a workshop announcement, as the draft and traceability sidecar claim.

form_readability.evidence: Paragraph and figure-placeholder use matches the contract's required_structures (one figure placeholder for the 4-tier governance diagram, no RACI table); the Product-Led paragraph is dense (5 products, MVP steps, and NESDC rationale in one block) but conveys the content correctly — flagged as a minor readability suggestion below rather than a rubric failure.

altitude.evidence: The section stays at decision-maker depth: no RACI matrix, no meeting cadence, no Business NFRs/Data Contracts; the MVP-sequencing and NESDC detail included is exactly the level the amended contract calls for, not full-report methodology.

headline_conclusion.evidence: The opening sentence states the governing principle explicitly ('เริ่มจากสิ่งที่ กรม สส. ดำเนินการได้ทันที...ไปสู่สิ่งที่ต้องอาศัยการเจรจาข้ามหน่วยงาน') and the closing paragraph restates the decision consequence directly, so the reader does not need to reconstruct the conclusion from project activities.

findings_over_process.evidence: The section foregrounds institutional stakes and recommendations (governance structure, platform sequencing, contract-milestone design) rather than describing how the consultant team worked; 'คณะที่ปรึกษาเสนอ' framing is used per house style to name the consultant as the actor of the recommendation, not as process narration.
